name: Nordic Unmanned AS
summary: Nordic Unmanned AS provides remotely piloted aircraft system services in Europe. It is involved in the development, production, sale, and operation of unmanned aircrafts. The company provides unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to monitor and measure the emissions from marine vessels to ensure that they are compliant with IMO regulations on air pollution from ships; and for complex logistical operations, such as onshore to offshore, ship to shore, and ship-to-shore. Its UAVs are also used for search and rescue operations, evacuation planning of burning buildings, border security, and criminal surveillance and tracking; collecting high-value data and processing to deliver digital solutions; and the inspection of infrastructure, such as buildings and power lines. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Sandnes, Norway.
